findings.problem: The voice starts rewriting the top as 4(x + 1) − 2 but never says why: a student does not see that this is what lets the fraction split into a + b/(x + 1).
findings.fix: Open the beat with one short reason, e.g. "To get the form A plus B over X plus one, we write the top using X plus one, so part of it divides exactly by the bottom."

findings.problem: "The sign of B over X plus one tells us where the curve sits" is the second half of the plan, but nothing is added to the board, so the plan is only heard.
findings.fix: On "the sign of", light the b/(x+1) part of the corner plan, or write a short line such as "sign of b/(x+1)?" under "Explain why c ≥ 4".

findings.problem: "Near X equals negative one the curve goes down forever, so every line below four cuts it" is the half of the argument that rules out c < 4, but it is only said; nothing on the sketch or board shows it.
findings.fix: On "near X equals negative one", draw the dashed line x = −1 on the sketch (or light the curve's left branch). On "every line below four cuts it", write a line such as "y takes every value below 4".
